page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on x86_64 architecture. It features 16 physical cores executing 32 vCPUs via Hyper-Threading at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU cache architecture includes 32 KB of L1d cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. System memory is provisioned at 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (4.0 GB per vCPU). The instance carries 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates under KVM virtualization, lacks local ephemeral storage, and includes zero dedicated GPUs. Supported hardware instructions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and BMI2.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a performance split between single-core and multi-threaded throughput. Single-core tests, such as Geekbench (995.0) and stress-ng single-core (1107.99), place the instance in the lower performance quartile. However, multi-threaded utilization elevates performance into average baseline tiers, reflected by a multi-core stress-ng score of 23637.07 and a PassMark CPU rating of 23223.67. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 96.24 GB/sec while write throughput measures 48.07 GB/sec. Application benchmarks demonstrate baseline multi-threaded capacity, with Redis SET throughput achieving 22.63 million operations per second and software compilation under Clang scoring 18474.0. Medium language model (7B) text generation operates at 11.18 tokens per second.

The instance offers balanced compute and memory allocation suited for horizontal scaling of general enterprise workloads without requiring specialized local disk hardware. A key tradeoff is single-threaded processing speed, where individual core throughput lags behind higher-clocked instances, requiring applications to rely on parallelism across its 32 vCPUs. The reliance on network-attached storage requires factoring network IOPS into overall architecture. The hardware configuration makes Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge suited for general-purpose application servers, microservice clusters, Redis cache nodes, static web serving, and build pipelines.

It includes 128.0 GB of system RAM, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, along with a 35 MB L3 cache and 10 Gbps network bandwidth. The server does not feature local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators. Benchmark data reveals lower-tier single-core performance alongside average multi-core results, highlighted by a PassMark CPU score of 23223.67 and a Redis SET throughput of 22.63 million operations per second. Uncached memory read throughput measures 96.24 GB/sec. Because single-threaded speed is constrained by its 2.5 GHz clock frequency, performance efficiency relies on leveraging multi-core parallelism. The instance is suited for general application hosting, web serving, microservices, and in-memory caching workloads.
